ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem does not involve image information that needs to be read, so solve directly according to the textual conditions. It is known that the solution set of the inequality ax^2-x+b\ge 0 is the closed interval [-2,1], which shows that the corresponding quadratic expression takes 0 at x=-2 and x=1, and that the quadratic function opens downward. Therefore one may set ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1). Expanding gives a(x+2)(x-1)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a. Comparing coefficients with ax^2-x+b, the coefficient of the x term satisfies a=-1, and the constant term b=-2a=2. Substituting a=-1 and b=2 into the target inequality bx^2-x+a\le 0 gives 2x^2-x-1\le 0. Factor it as (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0. Since the coefficient of the quadratic term is positive, when the product is less than or equal to 0, x lies between the two roots, so the solution set is [-\frac12,1].

method.method_draft: 把题干中给出的解集端点理解为二次函数的两个零点。由不等式 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集是闭区间 [-2,1]，可知对应二次式在 x=-2 和 x=1 处为 0，且开口向下。因此可设 ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a。与 ax^2-x+b 比较系数：a=-1，b=2。再代入目标不等式 bx^2-x+a≤0，得到 2x^2-x-1≤0。分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)≤0，所以解集为 [-1/2,1]。
method.CoT_raw: 题目不涉及需要读取的图像信息，直接根据文字条件求解。已知不等式 ax^2-x+b\ge 0 的解集为闭区间 [-2,1]，说明对应二次式在 x=-2 和 x=1 处取 0，且二次函数开口向下。因此可设 ax^2-x+b=a(x+2)(x-1)。展开得 a(x+2)(x-1)=a(x^2+x-2)=ax^2+ax-2a。与 ax^2-x+b 比较系数，x 项系数满足 a=-1，常数项 b=-2a=2。将 a=-1、b=2 代入目标不等式 bx^2-x+a\le 0，得到 2x^2-x-1\le 0。分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0。由于二次项系数为正，乘积小于等于 0 时 x 位于两根之间，所以解集为 [-\frac12,1]。

method.method_draft: 利用解集边界点必为等号成立点。因为 ax^2-x+b≥0 的解集边界是 -2 和 1，所以 f(-2)=0、f(1)=0。代入 f(x)=ax^2-x+b：当 x=-2 时，4a+2+b=0；当 x=1 时，a-1+b=0。联立两式，二者相减得 3a+3=0，所以 a=-1，再由 a-1+b=0 得 b=2。于是目标不等式变为 2x^2-x-1≤0。求根：判别式为 9，根为 (-1/2) 和 1；由于二次项系数 2>0，≤0 的解在两根之间，所以解集是 [-1/2,1]。
